capabilities: Sync notes with linked Trello cards in both directions (newest change wins)
View and edit Trello cards in a right-sidebar panel
Map folders to Trello lists and sync whole folders
Audit unlinked notes and cards and report Trello changes
Undo or partially revert past sync runs
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Setup requires generating a Trello API key and token; settings offer a dry-run mode to preview syncs without writes, and deleted notes always go to Obsidian's trash rather than being permanently removed.
motivation: The author credits nathonius's Trello plugin with inspiring the idea of connecting notes and Trello cards and helping motivate the project.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep notes in step with Trello cards in both directions, or to reconcile and audit links between a vault and a Trello board.

relations.evidence: nathonius's Trello plugin inspired connecting notes and Trello cards and helped motivate this project
Two-way sync between Obsidian notes and Trello cards: card side panel, folder mapping, link audits and undoable runs

summary: Two-way sync between Obsidian notes and Trello cards, with an interactive card side panel, folder-to-list mappings, link audits and undoable sync runs.
